# short-form-video-specs

> Safe zones in pixels for TikTok, YouTube Shorts, Instagram Reels and Facebook Reels on a 1080 x 1920 frame, with length and
> caption limits, as JSON that names each figure's source and the day it was read, transparent PNG templates, a JavaScript
> module and a command line tool. No dependencies. Code MIT, data and images CC BY 4.0.

On a 1080 x 1920 frame, text that stays at least 288 px from the top, 672 px from the bottom, 120 px from the left and 192 px from
the right, and out of the right 300 px below y = 840, is inside all four apps' published 9:16 safe zones at once. The apps publish
pixel figures only in their 9:16 ad guidance, so these are those presets, not a guarantee.

- [README](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-video-specs/blob/main/README.md): the tables, the CLI and the module
- [data/safe-zones.json](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-video-specs/blob/main/data/safe-zones.json): the boxes per app, with sources
- [data/length-limits.json](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-video-specs/blob/main/data/length-limits.json): length limits per app and route
- [data/text-limits.json](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-video-specs/blob/main/data/text-limits.json): title, caption and hashtag limits
- [data/speaking-rates.json](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-video-specs/blob/main/data/speaking-rates.json): words that fit a length
- [templates/](https://github.com/viewgum/short-form-video-specs/tree/main/templates): PNG overlays at 1080 x 1920

Run: npx github:viewgum/short-form-video-specs check --rect 140,900,600,200 --platform all
